title: Lost Wakeup via Signal-Before-Wait
pattern: A thread waits unconditionally on a condition variable without checking a shared state predicate.
why_bad: If the signaling thread sends the signal *before* the waiting thread executes the wait command, the signal is lost. An unconditional wait will block the thread forever, leading to a permanent lost wakeup and hang.
detection: CFG demonstrating a path to `wait()` on a condition variable that does not verify a state predicate first.
counterexample: A strict `while(!ready)` state check guarding the condition variable wait.
